competences.description: Attacks the enemy to inflict damage that ignores the enemy's Defense. Raises the shield to take the [Defense Stance] after attacking.
Attacks all enemies to decrease their Defense for 2 turns. Raises the sword to take the [Offense Stance] after attacking.
Increases the boss' Attack Power by 100% during the [Offense Stance]. Upon defeating an enemy, increases the Power of Relic. [Automatic Effect]
Increases the boss' Defense by 100% during the [Defense Stance]. If the damage the boss received from the enemy is 5% or lower of the boss' MAX HP, increases the Power of Relic. [Automatic Effect]
